name: subagent-broker
description: Native-first fallback runtime for real independent Codex subagents using isolated processes and Git worktrees.

interface.shortDescription: Run real fallback Codex subagents when native spawn tools are unavailable.
interface.longDescription: Prefers native Codex multi-agent tools. When the current harness lacks them, exposes a stateful MCP broker that launches independent codex exec processes in isolated Git snapshots/worktrees and preserves truthful lifecycle evidence.
